# Roadmap: Forward Deployed Engineer

A step-by-step plan to become a Forward Deployed Engineer, built from 6 topics in your notes. Engineer embedded with a customer to build and deploy the company's product (often AI) into the customer's real systems.

> **Draft, generated from your notes.** Every item links to the note it comes from. The order of topics is a suggestion; review and adjust it.

## The role

- **What they do:** Engineer embedded with a customer to build and deploy the company's product (often AI) into the customer's real systems.
- **Typical experience to be hired:** 3+ yrs
- **Technical skills:** Rapid prototyping, Full-stack development, Data integration & ETL, API integration with legacy systems, RAG & agent building, Debugging in customer environments, Solution scoping, Deployment & security reviews
- **Source:** [IT Roles & Terminology Atlas](../../IT_Roles_Terminology_Atlas/IT_Roles_Terminology_Atlas.md), line 61
